card.name: Unix man page section numbers
card.fires_on: The word "section" in explanations of Unix man pages, and the parenthesized section number in man page headers such as TMPFILE(3).

modes.label: Section in man text
modes.description: The word section when describing which manual section holds a command.
modes.example: you should type man command_name. If the command is described in more than one<< section>> you should give the section’s number also

modes.label: Man page header number
modes.description: The parenthesis or digit of the section number after a command name in a man page title line.
modes.example: TMPFILE(3) Linux Programmer's Manual TMPFILE(<<3>>) NAME tmpfile - create a temporary
